text.p: Shares of Nintendo Co Ltd rose to a high for this calendar year on Wednesday morning on the Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE) due to hopes that the exchange will start options transactions and that options in Nintendo will be among those traded, traders said.
By 0208 GMT, the major game machine and software maker had gained 190 yen to 9,310. It earlier hit 9,350 yen, a fresh high for this year.
The previous high was 9,120, marked on Tuesday.
The OSE is seeking to start option transactions on 20 individual shares on July 18, securities market sources said on Tuesday.
The OSE is trying to gain a consensus from securities houses on the issue, and is set to make a decision at its regular board meeting on April 15, an official at the bourse said.
